name: pvsyst-mcp
description: Automates PVsyst 8.1.7 through its data files and the documented PVsystCLI commands.
long_description:
Unofficial MCP server for **PVsyst 8.1.7**: projects, variants, components, sites and weather, simulation and results, operated through PVsyst's own data files and the documented `PVsystCLI` commands. Every write is snapshotted first and can be restored.

**Requirements:** Windows x64 with PVsyst 8.1.7 installed. Headless simulation needs a PVsystCLI licence; without it the CLI runs in TRIAL mode.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by PVsyst SA. No PVsyst code is included or decompiled.

tools.name: entorno
tools.description: Entorno PVsyst: diagnostico, licencia, logs y preferencias.

tools.name: disenar_sistema
tools.description: E2E en una llamada: coordenadas + kWp -> sitio -> proyecto -> dimensionado -> simulacion -> KPIs.

tools.name: listar
tools.description: Lista proyectos, componentes, modulos, archivos u objetos.

tools.name: leer
tools.description: Lee cualquier archivo PVsyst: proyecto, modulo, sitio, meteo, componente, objeto o bytes crudos (detectado por archivo).

tools.name: editar
tools.description: Edita campos, inserta o elimina objetos PVObject (byte-preserving, con historial).

tools.name: escribir_archivo
tools.description: Escribe un archivo dentro del workspace (con historial).

tools.name: proyecto
tools.description: Ciclo de vida de proyectos y variantes: crear, eliminar, renombrar, dimensionar, diagnosticar, anadir objetos.

tools.name: componente
tools.description: Base de datos de componentes: crear, borrar, importar, exportar o crear desde ficha tecnica.

tools.name: sitio
tools.description: Sitios y meteo: crear (coordenadas o CSV), convertir, geometria solar, horizonte y TMY de PVGIS.

tools.name: simular
tools.description: Simulacion: ejecutar (con filas/parametros opcionales), preparar entrada, estado, preestimar y barrido.

tools.name: resultados
tools.description: Resultados: KPIs, CSV, perdidas, mensual, comparacion, P50/P90, carbono, economia y entregable.

tools.name: workspace
tools.description: Workspace: crear, exportar, importar, exportar proyecto, historial de cambios y restaurar.

workspace.title: PVsyst workspace
workspace.description: PVsyst user data folder: the one containing Projects, ComposPV and Meteo. Leave empty to auto-detect it (%USERPROFILE%\PVsyst8.1_Data, Documents\PVsyst8.1_Data or Documents\PVsyst8.1).

pvsyst_cli.title: PVsystCLI.exe
pvsyst_cli.description: Path to the PVsyst headless command-line executable. Leave empty to auto-detect it.

pvsyst_gui.title: PVsyst.exe
pvsyst_gui.description: Path to the PVsyst GUI executable (also locates the read-only DataRO folder). Leave empty to auto-detect it.

experto.title: Expert mode
experto.description: Also expose the raw PVsystCLI passthrough and the GUI automation tools (15 tools instead of 12).
